summary: Veterans Scam And Fraud Evasion Act of 2025 or the VSAFE Act of 2025 This bill establishes a Veterans Scam and Fraud Evasion Officer within the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) to be responsible for fraud and scam prevention, reporting, and incident response plans at the VA. The bill also extends certain loan fee rates through June 23, 2034, under the VA's home loan program.

journey.note: Passed the House; waiting on the Senate
